tokens.bdb: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)

tokens.bdb: a covering (in a bad sense), i.e. blindness or obduracy
the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
